cases.title: Campaign policy inspection and update
cases.scenario: GM inspects Campaign policy then changes one authorized policy field.
cases.expected: Only the permitted field changes under expected_version and operation_id; hidden policy data is filtered and source Definitions are unaffected.

cases.title: Membership delegation without authority widening
cases.scenario: GM delegates a bounded Scene-authoring capability to an assistant GM.
cases.expected: Delegation is explicit, scoped and versioned and does not imply broader actor or content authority.

cases.title: Scene hierarchy and ordering
cases.scenario: GM creates a child Scene and places it in an explicit ordered outline.
cases.expected: Parent, child and order are stored explicitly; order does not invent branch or causal semantics.

cases.title: Scene template and branching
cases.scenario: GM adds a reusable Scene template reference plus a branch condition and outcome link.
cases.expected: Branch prerequisites and outcomes are explicit references and unresolved conditions remain unresolved.

cases.title: Reusable Setting reference
cases.scenario: Scene references a PPIA-12 Setting Definition.
cases.expected: Scene stores ownerDomain, objectId and objectVersion and does not copy or mutate the Setting Definition.

cases.title: Campaign-local override
cases.scenario: GM applies an allowed local label or state override to a referenced object.
cases.expected: Only field-bounded Campaign-local data changes; the reusable Definition remains intact.

cases.title: Upload map image
cases.scenario: GM uploads an image for a Scene map.
cases.expected: A versioned map-media reference with dimensions and provenance is created; later grid calibration never rewrites the uploaded image bytes.

cases.title: Replace map image safely
cases.scenario: GM replaces the Scene map image before a new launch.
cases.expected: A new asset or asset version is associated while prior snapshots continue to reference their pinned prior asset version.

cases.title: Square-grid calibration end to end
cases.scenario: GM sets cellSizePx and X/Y origin offsets, previews alignment and locks the calibration.
cases.expected: Calibration is separate versioned metadata; grid translation changes offsets, not source pixels or camera state.

cases.title: Camera pan versus grid translation
cases.scenario: Author pans the viewport after calibrating the grid.
cases.expected: Camera view state does not change cellSizePx or origin offsets and calibration identity and version remain stable.

cases.title: Single-cell and named-zone addressing
cases.scenario: GM defines square cell column 4 row 7 and a named zone called altar.
cases.expected: Square cell identity includes calibration version, the named zone has semantic identity and no distance-per-square value is invented.

cases.title: Multi-cell large vehicle placement
cases.scenario: GM defines a multi-cell area and places one Vehicle reference across it.
cases.expected: One placement references one PPIA-04 Vehicle object plus an area; no duplicate Vehicle object is created per cell.

cases.title: Items hazards and Encounter placements
cases.scenario: GM places an Item, a Hazard and an Encounter link in addressed map locations.
cases.expected: Placements preserve owning references and Encounter definition, simulation and balance stay outside PPIA-08.

cases.title: Move and relayer placement
cases.scenario: GM moves a Creature or NPC placement and changes its presentation layer.
cases.expected: Only Campaign-local placement metadata changes and the Creature or NPC Definition remains owned by PPIA-02.

cases.title: Gridless Scene locations
cases.scenario: Scene has no grid; GM defines north balcony and places an objective there.
cases.expected: Gridless semantic location is fully authorable, inspectable and accessible without pixel or cell assumptions.

cases.title: Dungeon room corridor wall and door construction
cases.scenario: GM creates room-floor, corridor-path, wall and door-opening primitives and edits permitted dimensions.
cases.expected: Geometry is versioned, renderable and semantically described; no collision, LOS, cover or movement rule is inferred.

cases.title: Dungeon terrain transition and tile operations
cases.scenario: GM creates terrain, a stair or portal transition and a reusable tile or stamp, duplicates a tile and removes one duplicate.
cases.expected: Operations are attributable and idempotent and primitive families remain authored geometry only.

cases.title: Hidden GM-only placement does not leak
cases.scenario: GM places a hidden trap and note while a Player opens map, search and count views.
cases.expected: Unauthorized projection omits existence before counts, search, layers, errors, exports, diagnostics, notifications and AI context.

cases.title: Governed reveal transition
cases.scenario: A hidden door becomes discovered for Players after an authorized reveal.
cases.expected: Knowledge state changes through a versioned mutation and the Player projection updates only after accepted reveal.

cases.title: Launch readiness and immutable snapshot
cases.scenario: GM validates readiness and launches a Session.
cases.expected: Snapshot pins exact Campaign, Scene, map, calibration, placement and visibility-policy versions plus Session-binding inputs.

cases.title: Post-launch recalibration isolation
cases.scenario: Author creates a new calibration after a Session launched on an older calibration.
cases.expected: Active Session remains pinned to the prior calibration and the new calibration applies only through a new snapshot or governed live amendment.

cases.title: Governed live-session amendment
cases.scenario: GM proposes moving a placement in a live Session and accepts the amendment.
cases.expected: Original launch snapshot remains attributable and the accepted amendment records exact changed references, versions, decision and durable Event evidence.

cases.title: Post-session outcome history
cases.scenario: After a Session, GM records a local outcome and inspects history.
cases.expected: Campaign-local outcome and history are attributable and role-safe and reusable source Definitions remain unchanged.

cases.title: Stale calibration expected-version conflict
cases.scenario: Two editors revise the same calibration version and the second submits a stale expected_version.
cases.expected: Second mutation fails safely with current-version and recovery information; no last-write-wins or silent grid movement occurs.

cases.title: Duplicate retry does not duplicate placement
cases.scenario: Placement response is lost and the client retries the same operation_id.
cases.expected: Status lookup or compatible retry returns the prior result; only one placement exists and no source object is duplicated.

cases.title: Accessible nonvisual map and revoked access
cases.scenario: A keyboard and screen-reader user authors through semantic Scene, location and placement views and later loses Campaign access.
cases.expected: Nonvisual path preserves required authoring meaning and revocation reauthorization removes protected Scene, map and history access without revealing hidden content.
